verdict.rationale: Bruno itself can publish collection docs as shareable HTML, and it offers an embeddable README button that lets others open a workspace or collection in Bruno. Together these give a thin first-party way to share APIs for consumption, but nothing shows an actual internal catalog or portal. missing for 10: a multi-API catalog or portal with discovery and search, internal hosting and access controls for a portal, in-depth docs on the publishing workflow, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can publish an internal catalog or portal where teams discover and consume our APIs

citations.quote: Write docs with your collections; publish as shareable HTML.
Embed a button in your README so anyone can open your workspace or collection in Bruno.
